name: Chichester Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at Chichester Baptist Church. Open Mon and Wed for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Chichester District Council Allotments
description: District Council manages sites including Whyke
image: and Lavant. Plots from £30/year. Waiting lists available. Includes water access and tool storage.

name: Chichester Community Orchard
short_description: Community orchard with heritage fruit trees
image: and plum varieties. Harvest shared among volunteers with surplus available to residents. Open during picking season.
